content: Read the task description on the left, under the cafe. Total Points tells you how many places you'll need to add the prop, and Input tells you exactly what you need to pass down as a prop.

You'll see a flowchart on the right, where you can click on any component to start. The component's information (mirroring a React component) will then appear in the console on the left. You'll also see where the 'cats'/'objects' are imported.

There will be input boxes for you to enter the name. Follow the exact spelling and casing shown at the top. Enter the input in all the places where you would pass the prop down, and also where you would use the prop (for example, ).
Once you've added the input, click the next component in the flowchart. Once you think you've passed the props down in all the correct places, hit Submit.
Only hit Submit at the end.
